synopsis: Standards Australia published SA TS ISO 21815.2:2023 for the communication interface, and it is listed on the Standards Australia store [f15157, f2874]. Chapter 3 identifies it as covering the J1939 CxD interface and adopting the J1939 interface specification [f2724, f2261]. Its testing requirements are those in ISO/TS 21815-2, although the supplied facts do not specify individual tests or acceptance thresholds [f2725]. Both Chapter 3 and the glossary state that it is not law unless incorporated; Chapter 3 specifies incorporation by a regulator or a contract [f2263, f15157].

relations.note: Both state that the standard is not law unless incorporated.
Identifies the published communication interface standard specifically as covering J1939 CxD.
Specifies adoption of J1939 rather than merely interface coverage.
Standards Australia store listing supports the publication claim.
Adds that the communication interface standard includes ISO/TS 21815-2 testing requirements.
